parameters.name: Concurrency
parameters.description: The number of concurrent threads for the istio-proxy.

parameters.name: EnableCoreDump
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable core dump for the sidecar proxy container. A core dump file is generated when a program crashes. Valid values:

- `true`: enables core dump for the sidecar proxy container.

- `false`: disables core dump for the sidecar proxy container.

parameters.name: ExcludeIPRanges
parameters.description: The IP address ranges for outbound traffic that is not intercepted by the sidecar proxy. This corresponds to the `global.proxy.excludeIPRanges` field.

parameters.name: ExcludeInboundPorts
parameters.description: The inbound ports for which traffic is not intercepted by the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: ExcludeOutboundPorts
parameters.description: The outbound ports for which traffic is not intercepted by the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: HoldApplicationUntilProxyStarts
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to wait for the istio-proxy container to start before the application starts. Valid values:

- `true`: waits for the istio-proxy container to start before the application starts.

- `false`: does not wait for the istio-proxy container to start before the application starts.

parameters.name: IncludeIPRanges
parameters.description: The IP address ranges for outbound traffic that is intercepted by the sidecar proxy. This corresponds to the `global.proxy.includeIPRanges` field.

parameters.name: IncludeInboundPorts
parameters.description: The inbound ports for which traffic is intercepted by the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: IncludeOutboundPorts
parameters.description: The outbound ports for which traffic is intercepted by the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: InterceptionMode
parameters.description:
The policy used by the sidecar proxy to intercept inbound traffic. Valid values:

- `REDIRECT`: The default policy. The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic in redirection mode.

- `TPROXY`: The sidecar proxy intercepts inbound traffic in transparent proxy mode.

parameters.name: IstioDNSProxyEnabled
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the DNS proxy feature. Valid values:

- `true`: enables the DNS proxy feature.

- `false`: disables the DNS proxy feature.

parameters.name: Lifecycle
parameters.description: The lifecycle of the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: LogLevel
parameters.description: The log level. Valid values: `info`, `debug`, `tracing`, and `error`.

parameters.name: Namespace
parameters.description: The namespace.

parameters.name: PostStart
parameters.description: The parameters that are executed after the istio-proxy container starts.

parameters.name: PreStop
parameters.description: The parameters that are executed before the istio-proxy container stops.

parameters.name: Privileged
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to enable the privileged mode for the sidecar proxy container in the security context. Valid values:

- `true`: The sidecar proxy container is a privileged container.

- `false`: The sidecar proxy container is not a privileged container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitAckSloCPUResourceLimit
parameters.description: The CPU limit for the sidecar proxy init container, which is specified in the ACK dynamic overcommitment resource format. This parameter is used to set the CPU limit for the sidecar proxy init container when the pod has the `koordinator.sh/qosClass` label. Unit: millicores.

parameters.name: ProxyInitAckSloCPUResourceRequest
parameters.description: The CPU resource request for the sidecar proxy init container, which is specified in the ACK dynamic overcommitment resource format. This parameter is used to set the CPU resource request for the sidecar proxy init container when the pod has the `koordinator.sh/qosClass` label. Unit: millicores.

parameters.name: ProxyInitAckSloMemoryResourceLimit
parameters.description: The memory limit for the sidecar proxy init container, which is specified in the ACK dynamic overcommitment resource format. This parameter is used to set the memory limit for the sidecar proxy init container when the pod has the `koordinator.sh/qosClass` label.

parameters.name: ProxyInitAckSloMemoryResourceRequest
parameters.description: The memory resource request for the sidecar proxy init container, which is specified in the ACK dynamic overcommitment resource format. This parameter is used to set the memory resource request for the sidecar proxy init container when the pod has the `koordinator.sh/qosClass` label.

parameters.description: The CPU limit for the sidecar proxy init container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitCPUResourceRequest
parameters.description: The CPU resource request for the sidecar proxy init container.

parameters.name: ProxyInitMemoryResourceRequest
parameters.description: The memory resource request for the sidecar proxy init container.

parameters.name: ProxyMetadata
parameters.description: The environment variables that are added to the sidecar proxy. The value is a JSON object. The keys and values in the JSON object represent the keys and values of the environment variables that are added to the sidecar proxy.

parameters.name: ProxyStatsMatcher
parameters.description: The metrics that are used for Envoy monitoring and statistics. The value is in the JSON format.

parameters.name: ReadinessFailureThreshold
parameters.description: The failure threshold for the readiness probe of the sidecar proxy container.

parameters.name: ReadinessInitialDelaySeconds
parameters.description: The amount of time to wait before the readiness probe is initiated for the sidecar proxy container. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: ReadinessPeriodSeconds
parameters.description: The interval at which the readiness probe is performed for the sidecar proxy container. Unit: seconds.

parameters.name: RuntimeValues
parameters.description:
The runtime parameters for Envoy in the sidecar proxy. The value is a JSON-serialized string. The keys in the object are the Envoy runtime parameters, and the values are the parameter values.

The following runtime parameter can be set:

- global\_downstream\_max\_connections: the limit on the number of downstream connections for Envoy.

parameters.name: SMCEnabled
parameters.description: Specifies whether to enable Shared Memory Communications over Remote Direct Memory Access (SMC-R) optimization. SMC-R optimization improves the performance of cross-node communication. This feature requires Alibaba Cloud Linux 3 and the elastic Remote Direct Memory Access (eRDMA) network device on the node.

parameters.name: ServiceMeshId

parameters.name: Tracing
parameters.description:
The custom configurations for Tracing Analysis. The configurations must be serialized into a JSON string. The Tracing Analysis configuration contains the following fields:

- `sampling`: The sample rate. This field is of the Double type.

- `custom_tags`: The custom tags. This field is of the Map type. The key of a tag is a string, and the value is a JSON object. You can specify one of the following fields for the value:

  - `literal`: The tag value is a static field. This JSON object must contain a `value` field that specifies the literal value. Example: `{"value":"test"}`.

  - header: The tag value is a request header. This JSON object must contain name and `defaultValue` fields. The `name` field specifies the name of the request header. The `defaultValue` field specifies the default value to use if the header is not found. Example: `{"name":"test","defaultValue":"test"}`.

  - environment: The tag value is an environment variable. This JSON object must contain name and `defaultValue` fields. The `name` field specifies the name of the environment variable. The `defaultValue` field specifies the default value to use if the environment variable is not found. Example: `{"name":"test","defaultValue":"test"}`.
